description: This file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeGatewaySync component in the OpenClaw project. It tests the JSON decoding of gateway trigger words, including sanitization, fallback behavior for empty triggers, and handling of invalid JSON.

classes.name: VoiceWakeGatewaySyncTests
classes.description: A test suite struct that contains multiple test methods for verifying VoiceWakeGatewaySync's JSON decoding functionality.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromJSONSanitizes
methods.description: Tests that JSON with trigger strings is properly sanitized to remove extraneous whitespace and empty entries.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromJSONFallsBackWhenEmpty
methods.description: Verifies that an empty or whitespace-only trigger list falls back to default trigger words.

methods.name: decodeGatewayTriggersFromInvalidJSONReturnsNil
methods.description: Ensures that invalid JSON input results in a nil return value.
